newsitem.title: UK: UK EU measure of CPI rises 1.8% y/y in March.
newsitem.headline: UK EU measure of CPI rises 1.8% y/y in March.

text.p: Britain's new measure of consumer price inflation, harmonised with European Union nations, showed consumer prices rose 1.8 percent in the 12 months to March, the Office for National Statistics said on Thursday.
Figures for February showed CPI inflation running at 2.0 year-on-year, unrevised from the original estimate.
The new measure is for EU comparative purposes and does not replace the UK retail price index.
